title: GOP Rep. Gill Calls for Fauci Accountability — 'I Want to See This Guy Go to Jail'
text:
During this week’s broadcast of FNC’s “Sunday Morning Futures,” Rep. Brandon Gill (R-TX) discussed the potential for accountability for former Biden health adviser Dr. Anthony Fauci, who led the nation’s response at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.

“Congressman, look, you have been a rock star in terms of the oversight,” guest host Jason Chaffetz said. “That’s near and dear to my heart, for sure. Tell us what you’re seeing here, because I understand that they had this prophylactic pardon for Dr. [Anthony] Fauci, but the reality is, there are a lot of other people in that food chain. What do you see with [David] Morens and what do you see happening potentially to others?”

Gill replied, “Well, you’re exactly right. It’s not just Fauci or Morens. I think there are several other people involved here. It seem to be virtually his entire team. And I think that the most offensive portion of all of this is not just the fact that they lied to the American people, not just the fact that they deliberately withheld information, that they did so illegally, that they used private e-mails, as opposed to official e-mails, so that the American people didn’t know what they were seeing, what the risks of some of the COVID remedies, potential remedies were. I think the most offensive part about this is that, this entire time, if any American spoke out against COVID lockdowns, against the COVID vaccine, against where — or spoke openly about where COVID actually originated from, they were not only kicked off of social media, not allowed, of course, on left-wing media outlets, but oftentimes were virtually shunned from civil society for saying the things that these government officials oftentimes knew about, but were hiding from the American people.”

“I mean, this is as tyrannical as it possibly gets,” he added. “And people’s lives were ruined with this, and these people ought to be held accountable. So I’m glad that Fauci was held in contempt. I want to see this guy go to jail. And I’d like to see — learn more about who knew what in the Fauci orbit and make sure that they’re held accountable as well.”
